articleTitle: The Role of Big Data Analytics in Driving Innovation in Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This paper delineates how telecommunications companies in Jordan can harness the power of big data analytics to enhance their digital marketing strategies. Its role is substantial in promoting creative businesses concerning intelligent technologies, as the telecommunications industry is fundamentally associated with it. The dynamic capability of an organization’s aptitude to build and reconfigure its external and internal competencies to tackle rapid environmental changes is unavoidable. This perspective suggests that digital marketing can promptly adjust its resources and processes to address environmental threats and opportunities. The capability of the dynamic framework is a persuasive instrument in the digital economy for producing, employing, and transforming business models. On the other hand, digital marketing enhances business performance, focusing on customer retention, brand loyalty, and customer satisfaction. Primary data was collected through the questionnaires for Zain Jordan, Umniah, and Orange Jordan, which was analyzed by SPSS to develop regression analysis. The curve analysis shows that the p-value for Zain Jordan and Orange Jordon are 0.576 and 0.339, respectively. Although subscribers showed confidence in Zain Jordon, but they need to minimize the complexity to enhance the performance.

articleTitle: Institutional Quality’s Impact on Moroccan Economic Growth: Insights from ARDL Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This study explores the correlation between economic growth and institutional quality, employing the Autoregressive Distributed Lag model. The primary objective is to investigate the relationship between these variables in both the short and long term. Our research outcomes indicate a positive impact of institutional quality on economic growth, which endures over an extended period. In the short term, a mere one-point enhancement in institutional quality is associated with a significant five-point surge in economic growth $(P - value =0.00\lt 5\%)$. Over the long term, a single-point increase in institutional quality is linked to a substantial nine-point acceleration in economic growth.

articleTitle: Assessing the Role of Toyota Distribution and Logistical Network in the Context of Global Challenge Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This paper explores and investigates the logistical and capacity planning framework adopted by one of the world’s leading automakers, "Toyota Motor Corporation". Therefore, this analysis explores the most prevalent philosophies employed by "Toyota Production System (TPS)" and their link with the literature on "Capacity Management, Supply Chain Management and Total Quality Management". Nonetheless, this analysis demonstrates how the Just in time (JIT) within the TPS achieved its distribution efficiency as well as inventory management purpose and proceeded to discuss the major drawbacks of this approach in the presence of the most significant challenges, such as natural catastrophes, recalls, and the coronavirus outbreak. And lastly, this research concludes with a recommendation that can best serve as a potential disruption mitigation strategy.

articleTitle: Enhancing College Education: An AI-driven Adaptive Learning Platform (ALP) for Customized Course Experiences
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to design an Adaptive Learning Platform (ALP) based on Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm for students taking college courses. In this platform, course content and methods are customized to meet the needs of individual students based on AI algorithms. ALP aims to provide efficient, effective, and customized course learning paths based on student level. This platform enhances student performance in the course learning outcome by adjusting the instructional content, pace, and delivery methods to the learner's individual needs and preferences. ALP uses Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm and data analytics techniques to analyze the student's learning behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses, and provide personalized recommendations on how to improve their learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Automatic Protection of Web Applications Against SQL Injections: An Approach Based On Acunetix, Burp Suite and SQLMAP
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Web application security is a critical concern in the digital world. One of the most common and dangerous vulnerabilities in web applications is SQL injection. SQL injection is an attack technique that allows a hacker to exploit security weaknesses in web applications that use SQL queries to interact with the database. This article presents a practical, step-by-step approach to detecting and exploiting the SQL injection vulnerability. The solution combined the use of Acunetix Web Vulnerability Scanner for detection, Burp Suite for capturing http requests containing parameters vulnerable to SQL injection, and SQLMAP as an automatic SQL Injection operating tool. The test was performed in a practical way using the real Damn Vulnerability Application and simulating SQL injection attack scenarios on each available security level: low, medium, and high. The results obtained showed very high performance of the solution at the different security levels, although the security mechanisms have been strengthened at these levels.

articleTitle: Conditional Cash Transfers Evaluation Using Instrumental Variables Technique: Impact Of The Moroccan Tayssir Program On Child Labor
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate the influence of Moroccan Conditional Cash Transfers (CCTs) on child labor involving boys. Our analysis employed a dataset obtained from longitudinal survey data. The Instrumental Variables (IV) methodology was employed to gauge the impact of these transfers on child labor. In summary, the outcomes derived from the adopted model indicated a statistically significant impact of the CCT program on child labor, particularly among children aged between 10 and 15 years. Notably, the Tayssir initiative exhibited a noteworthy reduction in child labor at a significance level of 5 percent. In light of the insights from this econometric investigation, it is recommended to prioritize household-based targeting over geographical targeting to enhance the precision of this public program’s beneficiaries.

articleTitle: Renewable and Sustainable Energy: Solar Energy and Electrical System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: In some parts of the world, our dependence on fossil fuels has lasted much longer than it should have. The transformation and sustainability of the energy sector can therefore be seen as one of the most important challenges we face today. The International Energy Agency (IEA) has published that the final consumption of electricity increases by 25% from 2020 to 2030 according to the Net Zero Emissions (NZE), of which the building sector accounts for nearly 32% of electrical energy. Thus, the orientation towards new energy sources remains the only way to meet our daily needs and to keep a sustainable autonomy. This article proposes a solution to the problem of ensuring a sustainable power supply for a building, and to do this it is necessary to rely on a methodology that consists first of making a collection of data for the various electrical equipment of the building, [1] then taking advantage of them for the calculation of energy needs. Finally, and after this assessment the sizing of electrical devices for sustainability and energy optimization.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Evolutionary Algorithms for Multi-Objective Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Recommender systems face the challenge of optimizing diverse objectives in personalized item recommendations. This study presents a comparative study of evolutionary algorithms for multi-objective optimization in recommender systems, evaluated using RMSE, precision, novelty, diversity, and coverage metrics on Movielens-10OK and Book-Crossing datasets. The support vector decision (SVD) algorithm emerges as superior with RMSE 0.89 and precision 0.42, balancing accuracy and diversity. We identify optimal combinations for each dataset: SVD with NSGA-II for Movielens-10OK and SVD with e-MOEA for Book-Crossing, achieving low RMSE, high precision, and diverse recommendations. The comparative results will offer valuable insights and suggestions to researchers seeking to choose appropriate algorithms that align with specific problem requirements.

articleTitle: Distribution and agentification of heuristic methods applied to complex systems in AI: a review of the literature
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: In this paper, we presented a review of the literature on the application of distributed and agentified heuristic methods to complex systems in AI. We begin by introducing the key concepts of distribution and agentification, and the benefits and challenges associated with their use in complex systems. Then, we review some heuristic approaches that have been developed to solve complex problems in areas such as optimization, planning, pattern recognition, learning, etc. In particular, we focus on heuristic methods that can be distributed and/or agentic, highlighting their main features and the results obtained in a concrete application. Finally, we discuss the future prospects and challenges of distributing and agenticating heuristic methods in AI.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of ChatGPT Tweets Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Large language models like ChatGPT by OpenAI have gained significant attention for their impressive performance across various tasks. They have become highly popular among adopters. Gaining an understanding of the sentiment of these adopters is crucial, as it can offer valuable information about the potential outcomes of the technology, whether it will thrive or falter, and the advantages and drawbacks it possesses.In this research, data mining techniques are utilized to analyze Twitter data and automatically categorize their sentiment polarity. A dataset of 15,000 English tweets is gathered in natural language from ChatGPT users, and text mining and data mining techniques are applied to convert them into a useful format. The objective is to build a sentiment classifier capable of predicting whether a tweet conveys positive, negative, or neutral sentiments. To achieve this, we utilize two widely used data mining classifiers: K-Nearest Neighbor and Naive Bayes. These classifiers are applied to analyze the sentiment of the tweets, and their overall accuracy, precision, and recall values are assessed, providing a comprehensive comparison between the two methods.

articleTitle: Turkish cashier problem with time windows and its solution by Migrating bird optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: A new application of the traveling salesman problem referred to as the Turkish cashier problem (TCP) was recently introduced in literature. The problem revolved around a cashier that must visit several locations and return to his office. To complete his visits, he can use taxis or public transportation and the objective is to minimize the total transportation cost. To make this problem more practical, we took time into consideration by adding a soft time interval for each location obligating the cashier to make his visit within. If he fails to visit within the adequate time, a penalty must be paid. We name this problem as the TCP with time windows (TCPwTW). A metaheuristic algorithm known as the Migrating Birds Optimization (MBO) algorithm coupled with mathematical programming was developed to solve TCPwTW. We attempted to find the exact optimum using an exact solver where for complex problems, optimal solutions cannot be found. The quantitative study reveals that for problems having a loose time interval, the Solver serves as the best approach. On the other hand, for problems having tight time intervals, the best solutions can be obtained by the matheuristic.

articleTitle: The Sovereign Credit Default Swap (CDS) variability and the Economic context vulnerability: the case of North Africa and MENA region
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: with the huge growth in sovereign default risk many countries, an increasing investigation exploring sovereign risk determinants.Two major literature directions will be examined in this paper:- Providing an overview of sovereign risk and sovereign credit default swap (CDS) as a risk measure and rating substitute.- Analyzing country-specific factors and global variables that affect sovereign risk,The study used panel regression to analyze eleven Mena and North Africa countries from Q1 2006 to Q4 2020.

articleTitle: Face Detection using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Face detection has received significant attention in many applications, including surveillance systems and facial recognition technology. To ensure security and improve the user experience, accurate and fast facial detection is crucial. This paper presents a new method using advanced deep learning techniques for face detection. This work introduced deep learning Pipelines using Keras TensorFlow and models based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) VGG16, VGG19, Resnet, and Inception. Our model produced classification accuracies of 99.38%, 99.08%, 87.10%, and 99.77%, respectively, for VGG16, VGG19, Resnet, and Inception.

articleTitle: Using machine learning and deep learning in additive manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The last few decades have witnessed concurrent progress in deep learning, machine learning, and additive manufacturing. Notably, applications of additive manufacturing (AM) have made significant strides forward in recent years, although their widespread adoption in multiple sectors is still undergoing development. Recently, various artificial intelligence techniques have found use in optimizing additive manufacturing parameters and predicting the mechanical properties of 3D printed parts. This article aims to provide an overview of the synergy between artificial intelligence and additive manufacturing. It also looks at the multiple applications of machine learning and deep learning in the context of additive manufacturing.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability in DC Microgrid Using Backtracking Search Algorithm PI Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Voltage stability is a challenging issue for autonomous DC microgrids. To maintain the voltage within the permissible range during operation conditions, PI controllers are widely used and adopted. This paper develops PI controllers based on the Backtracking search algorithm BSA, for ensuring voltage stability in a DC microgrid. The applied optimization algorithm searches the optimum PI parameters to keep the voltage on the desired value. In order to evaluate the potential of the suggested algorithm, a comparison is carried out with the genetic algorithm GA and particle swarm optimization PSO. The Matlab/Simulink environment is used to design and examined the control process. The comparative findings demonstrate that tuning PI controllers by the BSA approach achieves better performance.

articleTitle: ETL applied to Klarna e-commerce dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This paper examines the crucial role of Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes in managing and analyzing large-scale datasets, specifically focusing on its application in the e-commerce domain. The paper explores the challenges posed by big data and discusses how ETL techniques facilitate data integration, cleansing, and preparation for effective analysis. Furthermore, it presents a practical case study showcasing the application of ETL to Klarna e-commerce dataset, highlighting the benefits and insights gained from the process.

articleTitle: RNN-based Model for an Optimal COVID-19 Cases Detection using Clinical Reports
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The global impact of COVID-19 has been significant due to its rapid spread and high transmission rate. A large number of individuals have been exposed to this dangerous virus, emphasizing the importance of early detection to potentially save numerous lives. This research paper introduces an enhanced method for COVID-19 detection, utilizing a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and leveraging early clinical reports. Specifically, a Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model is trained using data obtained from the metadata of the available dataset published by the World Health organisation, specifically focusing on extracting clinical reports and labels. Several pre-processing techniques and word embedding are applied to train an LSTM-based classifier that accurately identifies positive COVID-19 cases. The implementation of this proposed approach yielded superior results compared to traditional machine learning algorithms. The model achieved a testing accuracy of 87%, and future works include expanding the dataset to enhance the efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Design of A Distributed Intrusion Detection System for Streaming Data in IoT Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Nowadays, IoT devices produce a large amount of streaming data that requires real-time analysis to ensure its security. Traditional security solutions are no longer sufficient to counter recent IoT attacks and to analyze the huge amount of data. In recent years, intrusion detection systems have been the subject of much research to evaluate their performance in detecting intrusions in IoT, especially since they are based on Artificial Intelligence and allow real-time intrusion detection. In this paper, we present the architecture of an intrusion detection system for streaming data analysis. We implemented our IDS in a Fog computing architecture and developed using Apache Spark. We applied several machine-learning algorithms to the NF-ToN-IoT-v2 dataset, and the results were promising.

articleTitle: A novel Passing Vehicle Search algorithm based Constraint Handling for signal timing optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a novel Passing Vehicle Search (PVS) algorithm based on a constraint management approach to optimize vehicle delay at intersections using SUMO (Urban Mobility Simulation). We aim to reduce vehicle delays at intersections, considering various factors such as traffic light schedules, queue lengths, and vehicle speeds. The PVS algorithm iteratively explores different configurations of traffic light schedules and other decision variables, evaluating their impact on vehicle delay. The fitness function considers the total delay experienced by the vehicles, and constraint management mechanisms are used to ensure the feasibility of the solutions. The experimental results demonstrate that the PVS algorithm effectively reduces vehicle delays compared to traditional approaches. The proposed algorithm provides transportation planners and traffic engineers with a valuable tool to optimize intersection performance and improve overall traffic flow in urban areas.

articleTitle: Effects of term weighting approach with and without stop words removing on Arabic text classification
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Text classification is a technique for grouping articles into pre-defined categories. Prior to categorization, text documents have to be set up and organised in a form that is compatible with the data mining techniques. That has produced many term weighting techniques have been developed in the literature to improve the functionality of text categorization systems. This paper compares techniques for text classification based on when stop words are eliminated from the documents once and when they are not. We used an Arabic data set of 322 papers grouped into six subjects (health, politics, science, education, agriculture and finance) to research which is the influence of prior weighting of features approaches on classification outcomes with regard to accuracy, recall, precision, and F-measure values. Each document subset includes 50 documents, except the health one that includes 61. We carried out four experiments and checked results getting that only for precision, the term frequency feature weighting approach with stop word removal are more or less the same than for binary method. Moreover the conclusion for accuracy, recall and F-measure is that Feature weighting approach with stop word outperforms the Binary one. Additionally, if the phrase for weighting is the same for both methods, to remove stop word increases classification accuracy for all the experiments.

articleTitle: Optimization of the care pathway for Increasing Public Hospital capacity using Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: During the COVID-19 health crisis, hospitals have experienced an agitated time in managing all patients with this virus. 2022 has seen an increase of 20% to 30% more patients hospitalized in emergency rooms than last year. The lack of human and material resources has worsened the situation. Not all hospitals were prepared to receive a large flow of patients in such a short time. This overload could jeopardize the quality of care. This study aims to optimize the care pathway of a patient with COVID-19 to reach the maximum capacity of the hospital. For this purpose, the process will be modeled using the collaboration diagram to identify the different interactions between the health professionals and the patient; then, this model will be optimized by indicating the bottlenecks. Finally, a simulation of this model will be established to validate the fluidity of the physical and information flow throughout the care pathway.

articleTitle: Signal demodulation with Deep Learning Methods for visible light communication
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Demodulation techniques are extremely important to ensure successful reception. Improving demodulation performance also improves the efficiency of a communication system as a whole. Traditional demodulators, with their high cost of implementation and tedious development, require dedicated hardware platforms. A single architecture for automatically demodulated end-to-end signals is suggested in this work. It is a demodulation based on machine learning (ML) for visible light communication (VLC), this suggested receiver which is based on learning can perform demodulation without any change in the receiver hardware by loading data on the network. The modulated signals are demodulated using a CNN-based demodulator, which turns them into images and then recognizes them. and there is still The RNN architecture which is powerful in terms of time series modeling. This type of receiver can intelligently and flexibly process several types of modulated digital signals. The outcomes reveal that the demodulation performances of data-driven demodulators are almost the same as those of conventional receivers. A combination of the strengths of the two architectures offers a more accurate demodulator, which is proposed in this work. a hybrid CNN and RNN architecture has shown its success in terms of its performance.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Guided Wearable Seizure Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological condition that affects millions of individuals worldwide and is characterized by recurrent seizures. Seizure detection and classification are crucial for effective treatment and management of epilepsy. In this study, we present the development and evaluation of EpiPatch, a wearable AI device for seizure detection and classification in epilepsy patients. The EpiPatch incorporates motion sensors and biosensors to measure heart rate, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation, allowing for a comprehensive understanding of the patient’s condition during a seizure. Using machine learning algorithms, the EpiPatch is able to classify different types of seizures based on their unique motions, enabling more accurate and effective treatment. The results of our evaluations indicate high levels of accuracy in seizure detection and classification, with an overall accuracy rate of 80 percent. The proposed system has the potential to significantly improve the lives of individuals affected by epilepsy, and further research and development in this area is necessary to fully realize the potential of this technology.

articleTitle: Prediction of Drug Reactions through Hybrid Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Everyday, doctors discuss drug prescriptions with different patients. Therefore, while prescribing drugs, doctors must be aware of all potential side effects of drug. According to the US Department of Health and Human Services, 33 percent of all hospital admissions each year were due to Adverse Drug Events (ADEs), also known as unwanted side effects. The goal of this research is to identify adverse reaction of drugs based on user’s reviews. Two techniques are proposed in this research named as Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Extreme Learning Machine (ELM). Further the hyper-parameters of proposed techniques are dynamically optimized through Random Search (RS) and Elephant Harding Optimization (EHO) techniques respectively. The performance evaluation matrices are used to obtain results of proposed techniques. Furthermore, proposed hybrid techniques ELM-EHO and SVM-RS are compared with some conventional techniques to prove superiority.

IEEE Keywords: US Department of Health and Human Services

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Proactive Traffic Incident Management
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The growing demand for people and products transit and the enormous intensity of population in metropolitan areas have raised the need for suitable infrastructure and system development to manage the continually rising and varied traffic conditions effectively. Ramp metering is one of the traffic management techniques that employ signals placed at freeway on-ramps to actively control traffic accessing the freeway. Ramp metering has proven to be successful at reducing recurrent congestion. However, more than half of all congestion is caused by non-recurring events such as accidents, construction zones, adverse weather conditions, special events, and others. Intelligent systems and their theoretical foundations in artificial intelligence have advanced tremendously in recent years. As a result, their application in everyday living has lately grown in popularity. This paper aims to demonstrate the ability of a machine learning control method known as reinforcement learning to react to changing real-time traffic conditions and adjust while managing highway entrance access during incident time. The guidance was developed using a microscopic simulation model that considered non-recurring traffic events. It also considers event characteristics such as incident location, clearance time, and the number of lanes obstructed. The recommendations were created using sensitivity analysis and statistical experiments. The findings are encouraging, demonstrating that the machine learning control method can provide optimum coordinated management of freeway entry ramps.

articleTitle: Design of A Distributed Intrusion Detection System for Streaming Data in IoT Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Nowadays, IoT devices produce a large amount of streaming data that requires real-time analysis to ensure its security. Traditional security solutions are no longer sufficient to counter recent IoT attacks and to analyze the huge amount of data. In recent years, intrusion detection systems have been the subject of much research to evaluate their performance in detecting intrusions in IoT, especially since they are based on Artificial Intelligence and allow real-time intrusion detection. In this paper, we present the architecture of an intrusion detection system for streaming data analysis. We implemented our IDS in a Fog computing architecture and developed using Apache Spark. We applied several machine-learning algorithms to the NF-ToN-IoT-v2 dataset, and the results were promising.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Second-Order Fractional Differential Equation: The Black-Scholes Equation for Call and Put Options as a Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate and apply the one-dimensional partial differential Black Scholes equation to the MASI Index in order to reduce market risk during the three months preceding the COVID 19 crisis. This research would be immensely useful in appraising equity investments in the context of the Moroccan equity market during stress scenarios, as well as testing the usefulness of the Black-Scholes equation in risk minimization. The one-dimensional partial differential equation can be written as follows:\begin{equation*}\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial t}+\frac{1}{2} \sigma^{2} x^{2} \frac{\partial^{2} \varphi}{\partial x^{2}}+r \cdot x \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial x}-r \cdot \varphi=0\end{equation*}

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence for Improving Internal Logistics in the Garment Industry: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This paper presents a literature review on the application of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve the balance of logistics and assembly lines within the fashion industry between 2012 and 2022. The study highlights the significant benefits of AI in terms of efficiency, productivity, and profitability. Using artificial intelligence technologies such as machine learning to optimize tasks, forecast demand, adjust production levels, and optimize resource allocation, resulting in significant cost savings. However, challenges such as data collection and management and the high initial cost of implementing AI solutions have been identified. The article recommends that fashion companies consider integrating AI into their internal logistics and assembly line coordination processes, and highlights the need for collaboration between researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers to fully realize the benefits of AI in apparel manufacturing.

articleTitle: Moroccan Public Administration in the Era of Artificial Intelligence: What Challenges to Overcome?
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The digital era has brought many benefits to the public system in the worldwide. It helped improving the quality of services offered to the citizen/costumer. Who is not any more obligated to be mobilized for beneficiating from services, which he could get on the internet in a few minutes. However, the development of the Artificial Intelligence and the significant increase of its users, make the Moroccan public system under new forms of pressure. The potential difficulties are due to the situation of the structure, which is not well prepared to join this new era, because of the sluggish process of digitalization.This article aims to explore the possible challenges that the Moroccan public administration may face for embracing the Artificial Intelligence solutions. The slow progress in adopting digital technologies has disadvantaged the public administration, while the world is moving so fast towards more complicated and more sophisticated AI solutions. The objective of this paper is to highlight the imperative obligation for the public system in Morocco to get over all the challenges in order to join the new era. The success of this process will automatically lead to a modern administration with less procedural complexity and more transparency. This work will also demonstrate how the change management can be a real lever for both of policymakers and civil servants, during the transition to the use of artificial intelligence solutions.This work is an anchor to a subsequent empirical study whose objective is assessing the organizational capacity of the Moroccan public administration to be completely digitalized, and start looking for adopting the solutions offered by artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Internet of Things-Based Air Pollution Monitoring System for the Indoor Environment Utilizing Light Fidelity Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Indoor air pollution is a major environmental health problem. Exposure to air pollutants can cause many negative health effects, including respiratory problems and heart diseases. To control indoor air pollution, continuous monitoring is necessary. This paper presents an air pollution monitoring system based on the Internet of Things (IoT), which refers to the network of physical objects embedded with sensors, software, and connectivity to enable them to exchange data with other connected devices and systems over the communication network. It is suggested to use optical wireless communication (OWC) via light fidelity (Li-Fi) that utilizes visible LED lighting for data transmission purposes. Visible light communication (VLC) was selected due to the current congestion of the radio frequency band, which is extensively employed for data transmission and unable to satisfy the requirements of the forthcoming 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation networks. In this paper, the air pollution monitoring system consists of a MQ135 sensor and a dust module sensor to measure polluted data in an indoor environment; the sensors are connected to the Arduino microcontroller for digital processing; and the measured data are transmitted to the ThingSpeak cloud by utilizing an ESP-32 module. The user can access the ThingSpeak web application to monitor air pollution levels through the VLC system. Optisystem tool V18 simulates the VLC system connected with fiber optic channel (FOC) and free-space optic (FSO) channels to transmit the link of the web application to the end user. This paper intends to verify the performance of the VLC system. The proposed system’s performance was evaluated based on the quality factor and the bit error rate (BER) at varying distances in dusty weather. The proposed system demonstrated a satisfactory performance up to an estimated distance of 1300 m in dusty conditions. Despite the challenging environmental conditions encountered by the transmission network, VLC has shown its capability to transmit high-speed data that satisfies user needs.

articleTitle: Detecting black hole attacks in MANET using baiting and timer technique with AODV protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: MANET (Mobile Ad hoc Network) is sensitive to attacks due to the lack of infrastructure and central control that influences on the adaptation of the security solutions of this network. The black hole is an active attack that can be inserted into the routing process to destroy the functioning of ad hoc networks. In this work, we choose the AODV protocol whose route requires two types of control packets: route request (RREQ) and route response (RREP). Therefore, the choice of this protocol is justified by the fact that reactive routing protocols work better than proactive protocols because they minimize control traffic. Indeed, the detection of the black hole attack is done by modifying the AODV routing protocol with the use of the baiting and timer technique (BTT) which is based on sending the fake address and checking it in the list of neighbors. The test of evaluation metrics such as packet delivery rate (PDR), number of packet loss and throughput are done by NS3 environment that provides better results compared to other simulators.

articleTitle: Imroving the Productivity Rate and Ergonomic Requirements using Motion and Time Study
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The industrial sector is based on several pillars to reach success and achieve its mission and vision, which are mainly the resulted productivity and the human worker. Accordingly, this research aimed to work on solving production problems in one of the garment factories in Jordan by reducing the gap between actual and target production quantity and Improve ergonomics at the same time by reducing the risk levels that exposed to workers. The methodology used in this research is path process chart technique which is a motion and time study (MTS) method that is an advances combination from the process and pathway chart to represent the path that followed by the worker during doing the processes of work to establish the best path based in MTS principles to improve ergonomics side. The study analyzes all processes needed to produce a T-shirt product from two assembly lines. As a result, the production quantity increased from 668 pc to 828 pc to each hour and the efficiency increased from 74.64% to 92.5% and levels of risk have decreased as shown at RULA and REBA assessment tools. It is recommended to use path process chart to analyze the work then eliminate the non-added value motions and reduce risk levels. Also, it is recommended to convert layout from S-shape flow pattern to U-shape flow pattern and redistribute workers to balance workload.

articleTitle: Improvement of an Algorithm for Resilient Assembly Line Balancing in Automotive Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The term “Resilience” became popular lately in the industrial sector and researchers became increasingly interested in manufacturing resilience during emerging situations. The manufacturing resilience describes the ability of a production system (Machine, Assembly line, Factory...) to respond to changes and disturbances. Therefore, we call a production system resilient when it maintains the required results (production rate, quality, failure rate etc.) regardless of the circumstances.During the COVID-19 period, all production systems were impacted by the changes caused by the virus, for this reason we propose in this article improvements in the classical Simple assembly line balancing problem Type-E (SALBP-E) mathematical model proposed in the literature in order to guarantee the resilience of the lines in the future.

articleTitle: Micro level data aggregation based on profiling and Jaro-Winkler distance maximization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This article explores a micro-level data aggregation method based on feature profiling and Jaro-Winkler distance maximization. The goal is to develop an efficient approach for data aggregation that takes into account the similarity of rows and provides high accuracy of results without using the ID of the objects under study. This approach preserves confidentiality and solves the problem of mismatching a set of data objects. As part of the study, a method based on the task of assigning and searching for similar profiles was proposed, which allows you to optimally match strings and perform aggregation. The results of experiments were presented, which confirm the effectiveness. Further development of the study may include the use of a multi-agent approach to reduce the dimension of the assignment problem.

Author Keywords: Row-by-row aggregation based on an optimization problem

articleTitle: optimizing Furniture Assembly: A CNN-based Mobile Application for Guided Assembly and Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Building products based o written instructions can be challenging for individuals, often leading to difficulties during the assembly process. This project presents a mobile application that guides users through the assembly process and verifies assembly correctness using image comparison techniques. The application features manufacturer and consumer modes, allowing manufacturers to add assembly steps and users to access provided assembly instructions for a given product. Cross-platform compatibility is achieved with React-Native and Expo Go, while image matching is implemented by incorporating computer vision and machine learning techniques, specifically utilizing a Siamese Network architecture. Amazon Web Services (AWS) supports content delivery and storage. An IKEA table and kids chair assembly serves as a demonstrative example. By offering step-by-step guidance and feedback based on similarity indexes, the application optimizes the efficiency and accuracy of furniture assembly. The project showcases the system’s practicality, particularly in enhancing the assembly process for various furniture items, exemplified by the IKEA products.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Mix Model for the UAE Considering Economic and Environmental Impacts
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: With growing concerns about climate change and increasing demand for energy, planning and decision-making for an optimal energy mix have become essential for policymakers, energy companies, and researchers alike. This study proposes an optimization-based methodology for determining the optimal energy mix in electricity generation in the United Arab Emirates from various energy sources, such as: natural gas, solar energy, hydroelectricity, biomass, and nuclear power, while simultaneously minimizing economic and environmental costs. The optimization model helps minimize the total cost for future investments in electricity generation capacities over 30 years which includes the installation cost of additional power plants, the fixed cost for annual operation and maintenance, the variable cost for operation and maintenance, and the emissions cost of energy sources. This model addresses energy demand requirements, annual installation capacities, peak demand, and renewable energy technologies. The results show that most future energy installation capacity is obtained from solar photovoltaic energy, followed by natural gas. In addition, CO2 emissions per kWh of electricity generation by 2050 can be reduced by around 10% without limiting fossil fuels and by about 20% with limiting fossil fuels.

articleTitle: Solving The Magic Square Problem Using Selection Hyper-heuristics
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Selection hyper-heuristics are high-level optimisation strategies the aim of which is to increase the generality of optimisation solvers. These have recently attracted substantial attention and effort from researchers in numerous areas including, but not limited to, operational research, artificial intelligence, engineering and computer science. A Magic Square is a matrix of nxn dimension, which includes all the numbers in $\{$1, 2, $\ldots, n^{2}\}$ such that the sum of each row, column and main diagonal is equal. With large values of n, it’s shown that finding the optimal configuration is hard. This is defined as a minimisation problem that aims to optimise a measure of error that describes how far a given configuration is from being a magic square. In this study, we present the results of testing twenty hyper-heuristics on various instances of the magic square problem. The empirical results reveal that hyper-heuristics that utilise a reinforcement learning selection method outperform all other hyper-heuristics in this study. In particular, with the increase in the complexity of the problem, a hyper-heuristic utilising simulated annealing as solution acceptance method in addition to the reinforcement learning proves to be promising.

articleTitle: Sustainable Component and Supplier Selection: Application on Data Center Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This research proposes a decision-making support tool to select the optimal sustainable component and supplier. The proposed approach contains a fuzzy technique for order of preference by similarity to the ideal solution (TOPSIS) established on environmental sustainability. Utilized in weighting each possible component supplier. A dual-objective binary optimization technique is developed in order to obtain the optimal solution. A case study will be conducted for data center components and supplier selection to evaluate the proposed approach’s effectiveness, especially when considering the large energy consumption of data centers.

articleTitle: Digits Recognition for Sign Language Using Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Sign language is a universally language for the deaf people. Various deep learning models have been used to classify the dataset images for recognizing the digits. To improve the classifiers `accuracy, this study uses two different transfer learning algorithms, specifically VGG-16 and Resnet for recognizing the digits of sign language. Then in the same dataset, we apply many augmentation techniques to measure the accuracy of the classifiers. The study results have shown that VGG16 achived 95% accuracy and ResNet 93% accuracy.

articleTitle: A Python Module for Selecting the Number of Assets in Optimal Portfolios via Two Alternative Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The current work presents a software component produced in Python by the authors that constructs the optimal portfolio using two alternative approaches. The first standard approach relies on obtaining the optimal weights via the minimization of the portfolio’s variance as a measure of risk. The second approach as alternative method mixes return and risk explicitly in the objective function and gives the needed portion of investment for each asset that results in the highest possible return per unit of risk. The current technique is coherent with the rational expectation that investors combine return and risk once decisions on investment are made. Our software package advances another benefit that is commonly overlooked in practice, which is determining the collection of assets for including in the portfolio endogenously. This software creates all potential combinations and accordingly the investor is able to discover analytically the portfolio that is the best one amongst possible ones. The module offers a graphical user interface (GUI), which makes it consumer friendly. An application is also supplied for demonstrating the way the software operates using real data of financial assets.

articleTitle: The spatial-temporal evolution of China’s import and export trade based on the spatial autocorrelation model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Based on the total import and export of goods, this paper measures the scale of trade in China. Data from 31 provinces and cities in mainland China during 2006-2020 were selected for quantitative research, and Stata was used for spatial autocorrelation processing, it finds that under the significance level α=0.05, the overall import and export trade in Mainland China shows a random distribution pattern. However, from the perspective of local spatial autocorrelation, Shanghai, Zhejiang and Jiangsu show a positive spatial autocorrelation, Hainan and Guangdong show a negative spatial autocorrelation, and other regions show a relatively discrete state.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection: A Performance Comparison Between YOLOv7 and YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This study focuses on the comparison of two state-of-the-art object detection models, YOLOv7 and YOLOv8, for the task of pothole detection in road images. The detection of potholes is crucial for maintaining the safety of roads and highways, and the use of computer vision algorithms has shown promising results in automating this process. Our aim is to determine which of these two models offers the best trade-off between speed and accuracy in pothole detection. We conducted experiments on a dataset of road images containing potholes and evaluated the performance of each model using object detection metrics such as precision, recall, mean average precision (mAP) and F1-score accuracy. Our findings reveal that YOLOv8 slightly outperforms YOLOv7 in terms of object detection metrics, achieving a mAP of 78.6%. These results demonstrate the potential of YOLOv8 for real-time pothole detection in road safety applications.

articleTitle: Optimazting Dynamics for Voluntry Retirement and Sustainable Living
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The current study aims to investigate the role of voluntary retirement decisions by employees of governmental sector in the Bahrain on sustainable living, particularly on the level of financial balance and quality of life. Investigate whether the results of the motives of the voluntary retirement decision on the quality of life of government sector employees. The Methodology used in this study is the descriptive-analytical study. Findings revealed that the main reason/motive for voluntary retirement was personal and health and psychological motives. Also, the causes of the voluntary retirement decision and the financial balance are positively correlated. The motives of the voluntary retirement decision and the quality of life are positively correlated. The financial motives were the most influential dimension of the voluntary retirement decision on the quality of life. The study recommends improving the conditions of voluntary retirement employees of government sector and handing more roles and responsibilities mainly to those with long years of experience to run the work and involve them in the decision-making process to motivate them at work.

articleTitle: Quantum Communication Technologies: Future Trends And Prospects For Innovation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Humanity’s social, economic, and technological progress could not have been made without communications infrastructure. The need to attain the sophistication of long-distance communication has grown steadily since the dawn of civilization. The modern global communications system is the single greatest infrastructural project in human history. The global telecommunications grid which uses satellites, deep-sea fiber-optic systems, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, microwave and other radio, and optical-frequency communications networks are tremendous in coverage, unparalleled in connection, and ubiquitous in application. As we approach the middle of the 21st century, this system’s next major update will incorporate quantum communications technology. Quantum communication, in tandem with quantum computing and quantum sensing, constitutes one of the three pillars of second-generation quantum technology and promises an array of novel applications. Considering the reliable transmission of quantum information often requires the transport of individual particles of light photons through a world inundated by trillions upon trillions of photons, quantum communication systems are an engineering marvel. To provide a technological alternative for existing public-key encryption protocols, which are now susceptible to the threat posed by future quantum computing systems, nascent commercial quantum communication networks aim to realize the potential for cryptographic security provided by the laws of quantum mechanics. However, a number of obstacles must be overcome before quantum communications can be widely adopted. This study focuses on the current state of quantum communication, the promise of its prospects in the near and far future, the obstacles it faces, and the breakthroughs and applications developed by the United Arab Emirates.

articleTitle: A Survey on Automatic Signal Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR), a potential radio technology, has a number of applications for maximizing the utilization of the useable electromagnetic spectrum. It can efficiently locate and exploit the unused spectrum for improved communication performance, which can help solve the recent surge in the use of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). While performing signal detection and extracting features from the transmitted signal with traditional methods is complicated. Deep learning, on the other hand, is a formidable technique that has seen significant success in a variety of applications. Therefore, deep learning for automatic signal recognition can remove all of this complexity because it does not require prior knowledge or human interaction. This article highlights existing research on the capabilities and fundamental uses of deep learning and the challenges in signal detection. Then, for future research, numerous open research paradigms will be discussed.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Model for Understanding the Relationship between Economic Intelligence and Artificial Intelligence* : *Exploring Connections for Decision-Making in Financial Organisation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This research work has attempted to trace the relationship between economic intelligence (EI) and artificial intelligence (AI) by applying an epistemological approach based on the theoretical model known as action research (AR). Using the action-research paradigm, it would be possible to conduct empirical studies based on questionnaires involving researchers, business intelligence practitioners and AI experts. This study could aim to understand how AI can be used to strengthen the capabilities of the economic intelligence system and improve strategic decision-making within financial organizations.

articleTitle: Productivity Improvement by Application of Kaizen in Assembly Line: A Case Study in Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The main objective of manufacturing industries is to increase productivity with high quality. Right now, many companies are facing problems such as high-quality rejection, unnecessary shifting, and high production costs. However, the ambiguity still lies in the selection of an appropriate tool’s Kaizen to reduce waste. Kaizen refers to increasing productivity, efficiency, and performance through the process of eliminating MUDA (unnecessary movements, surface) through small continuous process improvements.This paper proposed the implementation of Kaizen tools in assembly line balancing, and the main objective is to show how Kaizen can help to eliminate MUDA and ameliorate the efficiency of assembly lines. The outcome of this case study is the improvement of efficiency from 73.16% to 89.29% and the elimination of 3 operators.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Optimization Techniques in Electron Lens Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: To design electron lens systems, applying a fully automated optimization routine has not yet been feasible, especially for the case where the optimization has many free variables of the lens system, such as all parameters that define the geometry of the lens electrodes and the voltage of each electrode. Hence, the study of the implementation of different optimization procedures has not yet been possible either. In one of our previous studies, we have proposed to use the so-called Second Order Electrode Method (SOEM) which performs the electrostatic field calculations in a very short time by the approximations of the field near the optical axis. There, using SOEM in field calculation, a Genetic Algorithm (GA) was successfully implemented to optimize the electron lens systems. One of the questions that has not been studied and answered in the literature yet, is whether the GA is the most suitable option among different optimization techniques for the design/optimization of electron lens systems. In this paper, by implementing the SOEM technique as the field calculation method, different optimization procedures are implemented and their performances are compared. For this study, a typical six electrode lens system is employed. The implemented optimization techniques include calculus-based local optimization (‘Fmin’) and metaheuristic methods such as GA, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Simulated Annealing (SA). The results demonstrate that the population-based global optimization techniques like GA and PSO significantly outperform single-based local optimization methods such as ‘Fmin’ and SA. Additionally, PSO shows slightly better performance than GA, although it cannot be concluded that PSO will always outperform GA for every electron lens design problem. Furthermore, in the comparison between the two single-based optimization techniques, the metaheuristic approach (SA) outperforms the calculus-based one (‘Fmin’). Hence, we recommend implementing metaheuristic, global, population-based optimization techniques like GA and PSO for the optimization electron lens systems.

articleTitle: On the Required Iteration Number of the Representant Swarm Intelligence Algorithms Based on Coefficient of Variation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Determination of the required parameters for different optimization algorithms used in specific environments was and remains a hot topic of the informatics sciences. Selection of the right tool for the problem set is hard and careful investigation is paramount. This scientific study investigates the effectiveness of swarm intelligence-based optimization methods, namely Artificial Bee Colony, Grey Wolf optimizer, Multiverse optimizer and Salp Swarm Algorithm methods on four well known search space functions: Sphere, Rosenbrock’s Saddle, Rastring’s function and Ackley’s function. Coefficient of variation of the cost functions was used to evaluate quantitatively the performance of the analysed searching spaces. Ranking of the algorithms was done for each of the optimization problem wherein the SSA algorithm demonstrated a higher degree of favourability across the majority of the search spaces investigated.

articleTitle: Optimizing Edge Security: Comprehensive Analysis and Mitigation Strategies for Securing Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)

authors.preferredName: Gasm El Bary Mohamed El Hassan

abstract: This research paper delves into the security challenges posed by the rapid expansion of IoT devices, particularly in edge computing. By examining real-world scenarios in smart home security systems, medical IoT devices, smart transportation systems, and edge computing, the study thoroughly investigates the vulnerabilities associated with these IoT systems. The paper identifies common weaknesses, including insufficient encryption, outdated firmware, weak passwords, and inadequate physical security, which expose users to risks such as identity theft, data breaches, device manipulation, and infrastructure attacks. To address these concerns and optimize edge security, the paper proposes effective mitigation strategies tailored to each specific area. The recommended strategies encompass the use of strong passwords, regular firmware updates, encryption, network segmentation, authentication and authorization systems, robust authentication and access control, frequent security audits, and encrypted data and communication protection. The study emphasizes the importance of collaboration among stakeholders, such as manufacturers, regulators, and users, to implement these measures and enhance the security and dependability of IoT systems, specifically in the context of edge computing. By prioritizing security, users can confidently embrace IoT technology while safeguarding their privacy and well-being. This research provides valuable insights and actionable recommendations for optimizing edge security and addressing the evolving challenges in the field of edge computing.

articleTitle: Further results on delay dependent robust stability criteria for T-S fuzzy systems with state delay
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: This paper aims to address the issue of delay dependent stability in nonlinear Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems with interval-time-varying delays. The authors suggest a model transformation using a three terms approximation of delayed state variables. They also apply a scaled small gain (SSG) theorem and a novel Lyapunov Krasovskii functional (LKF) to derive stability criteria in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). The performance of the approach is demonstrated through numerical examples and compared with previous works.

articleTitle: New approach to solve Uncapacitated Facility Location Problem using Continuous Hopfield Network and modified K-means clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: Our work addresses a new method to handle the Uncapacited Facility Location Problem using neural networks and K-means clustering algorithm. In the first phase, we use the Maximum Stable Set Problem (MSSP) and the Continuous Hopfield Network (CHN) to determine the initial number of facilities to establish and their optimal locations. The second one consists to, based on results of the first step and using an improved K-means clustering technique, assign customers to the corresponding facilities in order to achieve the lowest possible overall cost of the process. Experiments, evaluations and comparison with the exact solution of the Uncapacited Facility Location Problem are carried out with various data sets, and it yields good results regarding quality of solution and the execution time.

articleTitle: Applying Computational Intelligence, Visual Optimization Tools, and Synchronized PAYLOAD’s Handshaking to Enhance Greenhouses ECC Cyber Security-based Agriculture IoT’s Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: One of the necessities of life is Food and its global availability has made agriculture a vital sector in recent years. With the development of technology, maintaining a good greenhouse climate has become a necessity to make plants more productive. The introduction of IoT technology solves many problems and offers new opportunities for improving efficiency and sustainability. Communication protocols such as MQTT and I2C play an essential role in data collection and exchange between agricultural IoT devices. However, data security remains a major challenge to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information. Furthermore, payload optimization and the application of advanced techniques such as real-time data synchronization, psychovisual coding, and data computational intelligence are essential in increasing IoT Greenhouse’s performance. Data analysis tools are critical in approximating missing or erroneous sensor values, allowing farmers to make informed decisions. The combination of all these factors provides new solutions for achieving sustainable, energy-efficient agricultural practices. This article focuses on Psychovisual Optimization tools, ECC for PAYLOAD’s security and data analytics for prediction, discuss the choice of fixed and mobile nodes, and explore at how different approaches influence energy efficiency, environmental preservation, and overall performance’s system.

articleTitle: Optimizing Remote Patient Monitoring Security’s Features Managing Compacted Real Time IoT PAYLOAD Deploying Light Weighted Encryption and Foveal Quality Optimization Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: The prevalence of chronic diseases necessitates continuous monitoring and frequent medical consultations, posing challenges in terms of resource availability and timely appointments. Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) systems offer a solution by enabling continuous monitoring and real-time communication between patients and healthcare providers. The increasing size of transmitted data, energy consumption and the need for real-time responsiveness are identified as key issues. This paper focuses on optimizing the RPM system, with an emphasis on data security and transmission efficiency. Our research aims to enhance the efficiency and reliability of RPM by proposing solutions that optimize communication protocols, data management, and security measures. These findings contribute to the advancement of RPM systems, ensuring effective remote monitoring and timely healthcare interventions for patients with chronic illnesses. The transmission of data from sensors and the communication between nodes and the cloud are examined, considering the security requirements of the IoT platform. To tackle these challenges, the paper presents four optimization approaches/tools for both the system and payload. These tools encompass enhancing communication between the cloud and nodes, optimizing node-level information, reducing payload size prior to data transmission, and implementing data compression techniques in conjunction with a feature-based psychovisual coding approach. The proposed optimizations aim to enhance the overall performance and efficiency of the system, ensuring timely response and reliable data transmission.

articleTitle: Deploying Computational Intelligence AI and Visual Quality Optimization Tools In Embedded Image Watermarking to Enhance the Agricultural IoT PAYLOAD Features
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: In this work, we propose an agricultural IoT platform, which helps the farmers and all the stakeholders in the food value chain, such as agribusiness professionals, marketers or even the consumer each at its level of use, to send, authenticate and protect these products from the producer to the final consumer.This solution is composed of a photo camera, QrCode generators, QrCode identification readers to read the content of the QrCode, i.e. details about the agricultural products, and an intelligent object recognition system to ensure that the QrCode is appropriate for the agricultural product being identified. To optimize the data transmission, captured from the recipient in terms of execution time, bandwidth, storage space and energy consumption, the proposed solution deploys SPIHT visual coding [1], Foveal coding [2], artificial intelligence for decision making, CoAP communication protocol [3], ECC security encryption [4] and Watermarking [5]to ensure the security of the QrCode during its transmission.The use of this solution will allow to battle against the fraud and the theft of the property of the agricultural products by sending the photo of the agricultural product and its QrCode with full security and optimizing their sending. time and virtual.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Optimization in Smart Grids: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)

authors.preferredName: Gasm El Bary Mohamed El Hassan

abstract: This study examines the security risks posed by IoT-based smart grid equipment and proposes practical mitigation measures. Smart grids offer benefits such as improved service quality, cost reduction, and energy stability through advanced technology and intelligent devices. However, their internet connectivity makes them susceptible to cyberattacks, necessitating in-depth research and security precautions. The study focuses on key components like smart meters, smart microgrids, and smart inverters that enable efficient energy management and integration of renewable sources. It identifies vulnerabilities and investigates security flaws. Denial-of-service attacks pose a significant risk to smart meters, while malware attacks compromise operations and data privacy. Fake data injection attacks and latency disruptions affect smart microgrids. To address these risks, the study suggests tactics such as anomaly detection, binary visualization, differential privacy techniques, authentication systems, and blockchain technology. These measures detect cyber-attacks, expose malware, preserve data privacy, ensure authorized access, and enhance the security of smart grids through decentralized connections and consensus processes. Overall, this study offers practical mitigation measures to enhance the security and integrity of IoT-based smart grid equipment, enabling reliable and resilient grid operations.

articleTitle: Training an LSTM-based Seq2Seq Model on a Moroccan Biscript Lexicon
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: In today’s increasingly multilingual world, where diverse scripts coexist, training natural language processing (NLP) models on biscript lexicons holds immense value. This approach allows for a deeper understanding and more accurate analysis of text data by encompassing multiple writing systems. It enhances language processing tasks like translation and sentiment analysis by capturing nuances and contextual cues specific to each script. Additionally, it promotes cross-cultural communication, inclusivity, and collaborative knowledge sharing. By training models on biscript lexicons, we can achieve more accurate translation, language generation, and language understanding across different scripts. This paper aims to evaluate the performance of a Sequence-to-Sequence (Seq2Seq) model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture. The evaluation focuses on a biscript lexicon within the context of the Moroccan language. While Seq2Seq models have shown promise in various natural language processing tasks, their application to biscript lexicons remains relatively unexplored. Our approach involves constructing a Moroccan biscript lexicon where each entry is represented in both Arabizi and Arabic writing scripts. Subsequently, we will train our LSTM-based Seq2Seq model using various optimization techniques to enhance its effectiveness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimization of the prediction performance in the future exchange rate
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Optimization and Applications (ICOA)
abstract: International trade is one of the most important elements in both national and global economies. It involves transactions in different currencies, requiring exchange rate conversions. Fluctuations in exchange rates can have significant implications for international trade. Currency risk arises from these fluctuations and can impact the profitability and stability of international trade. Currency risk management strategies, such as hedging and diversification, are employed by businesses and investors to mitigate the adverse effects of currency fluctuations on trade and financial transactions. To cover that risk, machine learning techniques offer valuable tools for addressing currency risk. By analyzing historical exchange rate data, macroeconomic indicators, and other relevant factors, machine learning algorithms can uncover patterns and relationships that influence currency movements. In this article, we’re going to use the random forest algorithm that is a suitable choice for addressing currency risk due to its strengths in handling complex and non-linear relationships. And we’re going to use Bayesian optimization algorithm to optimize the parameters and configurations of this machine learning algorithm and minimize the cross-validation value to manage the risk of the currency.
